title: The Gene Krupa Story
description: The jazz drummer (Sal Mineo) alienates his girlfriend (Susan Kohner) and his buddy (James Darren), goes to jail and makes a comeback.

title: Cabin in the Sky
description: Agents of heaven and hell fight for Little Joe's (Eddie "Rochester" Anderson) soul after his wife (Ethel Waters) gets him a pardon.

title: Reet, Petite and Gone
description: To claim his inheritance a jazzman (Louis Jordan) must find the right kind of woman.

title: Hi-De-Ho
description: The jealous girlfriend (Jeni Le Gon) of a possessive singer/bandleader (Cab Calloway) tries to have him killed.

title: Mystery Street
description: A Harvard doctor's (Bruce Bennett) study of a female skeleton leads a Boston police detective (Ricardo Montalban) to a killer.

title: Bad Day at Black Rock
description: A stranger incurs the wrath of racists when he arrives with a medal for a fallen Japanese-American war hero's family.

title: Edge of Doom
description: A parish priest (Dana Andrews) whose predecessor was slain extracts a confession from an angry young man (Farley Granger).

title: Witness for the Prosecution
description: An aging barrister (Charles Laughton) defends a man (Tyrone Power) for murder despite damaging testimony from the accused's wife (Marlene Dietrich).

title: Seven Days in May
description: An aide (Kirk Douglas) discovers his general's (Burt Lancaster) Pentagon plot and tells the president (Fredric March).

title: The Swimmer
description: Based on John Cheever's story about a middle-aged man's reflections on life while traversing suburban pools.

title: The Professionals
description: A circa-1917 rancher sends mercenaries (Lee Marvin, Burt Lancaster) to rescue his kidnapped wife (Claudia Cardinale) from a Mexican bandit.

title: Birdman of Alcatraz
description: Murderer Robert Stroud (Burt Lancaster) spends decades in solitary confinement studying birds and their diseases.

title: Elmer Gantry
description: An Oscar-winning adaptation of the Sinclair Lewis novel about religious fervor in small-town America.

title: The Train
description: A railroad boss (Burt Lancaster) helps the Resistance stop a Nazi colonel (Paul Scofield) from smuggling French art.

title: The Gypsy Moths
description: Two old skydivers and their young partner give a crowd its money's worth.

title: Princess O'Rourke
description: A down-to-earth pilot (Robert Cummings) charms a European princess (Olivia de Havilland) on vacation in the United States.

title: Marie Antoinette
description: The 18th-century Austrian princess (Norma Shearer) has an affair with a Swedish count (Tyrone Power) and becomes queen of France.

title: The Swan
description: A European princess (Grace Kelly) waltzes with her tutor (Louis Jourdan) but is destined to marry a crown prince (Alec Guinness).

title: Her Highness and the Bellboy
description: A New York hotel bellboy (Robert Walker) forgets his girlfriend (June Allyson) after meeting a European princess (Hedy Lamarr).

title: The Glass Slipper
description: Mistreated by her stepmother and stepsisters, scullery maid Ella (Leslie Caron) finally meets her prince (Michael Wilding).

title: The Pirate
description: An actor (Gene Kelly) woos a Caribbean islander (Judy Garland) by posing as the pirate (Walter Slezak) of her dreams.

title: The Prisoner of Zenda
description: Court followers foil a plot by having a British look-alike (Ronald Colman) pose as the king of Ruritania.

title: Edge of Eternity
description: An Arizona lawman (Cornel Wilde) traps a killer gold thief (Mickey Shaughnessy) and his hostage (Victoria Shaw) in a yellow tram spanning the Grand Canyon.

title: Easy Rider
description: Two free spirits (Peter Fonda, Dennis Hopper) on chopped motorcycles clash with the Establishment and meet a boozy lawyer (Jack Nicholson) as they cross America.

title: The Grapes of Wrath
description: Poor sharecroppers, the Joads leave dust bowl Oklahoma in hope of better luck in California.

title: Roadhouse 66
description: Car trouble strands an Ivy Leaguer (Judge Reinhold) and a hitchhiker (Willem Dafoe) in an Arizona town over Labor Day weekend.

title: Paris, Texas
description: A lost man (Harry Dean Stanton) surfaces, reunites with his brother (Dean Stockwell) and son, and finds his wife (Nastassja Kinski) working in a peep show.

title: Three Daring Daughters
description: Sisters resent their divorced magazine-editor mother's (Jeanette MacDonald) new husband, a concert pianist (Jose Iturbi) she met while on vacation.

title: Anchors Aweigh
description: Two sailors (Frank Sinatra, Gene Kelly) on leave in Hollywood help an actress (Kathryn Grayson) get her big break.

title: Take Me Out to the Ball Game
description: Two dancing baseball players (Gene Kelly, Frank Sinatra) run into trouble with their team's new female owner (Esther Williams) and a gambler who doesn't want them to win the pennant.

title: Thrill of a Romance
description: A honeymooning bride finds herself falling in love with an Army major when her groom is called away on business.

title: No Leave, No Love
description: A radio singer (Pat Kirkwood) stalls a Marine hero (Van Johnson) just back from the Pacific with his buddy (Keenan Wynn).

title: For Me and My Gal
description: Vaudeville song-and-dance partners (Judy Garland, Gene Kelly) separated by World War I reunite in love on Broadway.

title: Living in a Big Way
description: A World War II pilot (Gene Kelly) comes home to a bride (Marie McDonald) who, spoiled by her father (Charles Winninger), now wants a divorce.

title: The Diary of Anne Frank
description: A German-Jewish girl (Millie Perkins) and her family spend two years in an Amsterdam attic hiding from the Nazis.

title: The Best of Everything
description: A Manhattan career woman (Joan Crawford) and her publishing-house colleagues have affairs with married men.

title: Marnie
description: A man struggles to break the thieving habits of his kleptomaniac wife and restore harmony to their marriage.

title: A Fine Madness
description: Frustrated poet Samson (Sean Connery), who finds societal conventions maddening, lives in New York with Rhoda (Joanne Woodward), sees a psychiatrist and fights writer's block.

title: MGM Parade Show
description: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films.

title: Big News
description: A boozing reporter (Robert Armstrong) is framed for murder by the gangland advertiser who gets him fired.

title: Age of Consent
description: A college man (Richard Cromwell) and his underage girlfriend (Dorothy Wilson) must choose between marriage or his diploma.

title: The Half-Naked Truth
description: A carnival barker passes off an exotic dancer as a Turkish princess, elevating her to fame at a price he hadn't anticipated.

title: Gabriel Over the White House
description: Sobered by an archangel, the president (Walter Huston) fires his crooked Cabinet and becomes a world leader.

title: What Every Woman Knows
description: A Scottish barrister's (Brian Aherne) humble wife (Helen Hayes) edits him to eloquence in Parliament.
